_comment: Measured optical operating points for the injection-moulded ring gear,
side A, 32:1. Crossing duty is INVERSE to reflectance (lower = brighter);
the home feature is a reflector, ACTIVE when crossing < T.
These are reference / power-on fallback values. The homing routine is
self-calibrating (see HOME_ROUTINE_DESIGN.md) and should not depend on

unpainted.lighting: room ambient; unlit room overnight (NOT an enclosed sensor)
unpainted.background_note: censored - never crosses at any threshold 0..255, in any lighting condition tested
unpainted.reliability: 3593/3593 homes over 18 h, 33 recalibrations, zero failures
unpainted.enclosed_caveat: with a physical cover over the sensor the band collapses to 2 counts (T=252-253) and T=253 becomes bimodal; an unlit room is NOT equivalent to an enclosure

painted_silver.T_op_rationale: band centre (~26 counts margin each side) and top of the low-sensitivity width zone; NOT chosen for repeatability - no threshold showed a reproducible repeatability advantage
painted_silver.background_note: still censored (>255); paint does not make T = background - k viable
painted_silver.reliability: 190/190 homes in one session (no overnight bake yet)
painted_silver.specular_artefacts: none found - single clean segment T=200..252
painted_silver.untested: band with the sensor cover fitted - the decisive test for enclosed modules

painted_silver_production_v6.instrument: PortalFW homeSwitchCensusRoutine (`:n <T>` on USART1), one lap per threshold at 24000 usteps/s, driven from PortalTestBench
painted_silver_production_v6.note: First census taken on a PRODUCTION v6 module through the production firmware, rather than on the HomeSwitchTest bench rig. Both axes, silver-painted flags.
painted_silver_production_v6.T_op_rationale: band centre under the same floor + 0.55*span rule the self-calibration uses (210 + 25). 25 counts above the worse axis's floor, 20 below the ceiling, and clear of the 250+ smear zone where the flag exceeds 800 usteps.
painted_silver_production_v6.T_floor_axis_b: <=175 (still detecting at the bottom of the sweep)
painted_silver_production_v6.T_shoulder: >255 (no dither split anywhere; exactly one segment per lap at every threshold that saw the flag)
painted_silver_production_v6.background_note: still censored (>255) between flags, unchanged by paint
painted_silver_production_v6.reliability: 4/4 unattended production startups from reboot, both axes, adopting the default with no calibration; 16-17 s per axis
painted_silver_production_v6.prior_axis_b_history: this is the same axis B that had NO detectable flag at any threshold before painting - the paint is what made it work
